note: Voice sheets: who each speaker is, how they talk, what they'd never say, and sample lines. The generation script sends these with every request; the review mode shows them beside each line.

mara.name: Mara
mara.table: Earnest, organized and a little intense about the story. Keeps color-coded notes, has theories, and gets genuinely emotional about the plot and her character. Warm with everyone, quietly impatient when a fight drags. Talks in full sentences and asks questions.
mara.character: Thessaly is an elf wizard: precise, bookish and calm, with a dry wit. She cites books, footnotes and theories.
tics: cites page numbers and books (in character)
samples_table: I made a recap. It's color-coded.
Okay, I have three theories and a snack.
Wait, that's connected to the plot, isn't it?
I'm taking notes on that fight.
mara.chat: Proper punctuation, longer messages, sometimes a follow-up question. Rare emoji-free enthusiasm with exclamation marks.

relationships.dev: Fond, but sighs when he rushes past clues.
relationships.jess: Loves her, braces for her chaos.

mara.thread: why Thessaly came on the adventure

dev.name: Dev
dev.table: Loud, sunny and impatient. Lives for initiative, big numbers and cool weapons. Superstitious about his dice (lucky dice, dice jail). Short punchy sentences, lots of energy, good-natured trash talk. Long talky scenes make him fidget.
dev.character: Brannoc is a human fighter of few words: gruff, blunt and protective. Big sword, bigger feelings, mostly the sword.
tics: talks about his dice like they have moods
samples_table: That die is going in dice jail.
I brought the good dice. The lucky ones.
Can we fight something tonight? Please?
samples_character: I'm the muscle. Just so you know.
dev.chat: Short bursts, all-caps for excitement, sometimes several messages in a row. Never long.

relationships.mara: Respects her brain, teases her notes.
relationships.jess: Constant friendly rivalry; Pip and Brannoc bicker.
relationships.sam: His buddy; counts on Oswin's heals.

dev.thread: why Brannoc came on the adventure

jess.name: Jess
jess.table: Theatrical and mischievous. Does voices, narrates her own flips, talks to every NPC and pokes things she shouldn't. Quick and playful, loves a bit, and drops into Pip's voice mid-sentence. Never mean; the chaos is affectionate.
jess.character: Pip is a halfling rogue and smooth talker: flamboyant, charming, calls people darling, has a pet rat. Deflects with jokes and a coin trick.
tics: narrates in third person (Pip does a flip)
never: stealing from the party (only joking about it)
samples_table: Pip has a new accent. You'll love it.
Is it okay if Pip has a pet rat now?
Can I describe how badly that goes?
Pip would like to file a complaint.
Tell my rat I loved him.
samples_character: Lovely to meet you. Truly. Lovely.
What's that behind your ear? Oh, a coin.
Brannoc, try smiling. People like it.
jess.chat: Playful, theatrical, stage directions in asterisks are fine (*bows*). Medium length.

relationships.mara: Winds up her theories on purpose.
relationships.dev: Favorite target for teasing; Pip vs Brannoc is a running bit.
relationships.sam: Adores him; calls Oswin a saint.

jess.thread: why Pip came on the adventure

sam.name: Sam
sam.table: Easygoing host energy. Here for friends and snacks, keeps everyone fed, low-key and kind. Quietly sharp when tactics matter (who needs healing, focus the boss). Hates being put on the spot. Short lines, gentle humor, a bit self-deprecating.
sam.character: Oswin is a human cleric: warm, patient and practical, like a young country priest. Offers soup and blessings, and worries about everyone.
samples_table: Chips are on the counter. The spicy ones.
Okay, focus fire on the boss.
samples_character: Are you hungry? We have soup.
sam.chat: Short and friendly, lowercase is fine, rarely more than a sentence or two.

relationships.dev: Patches him up, laughs at his dice superstitions.
relationships.jess: Indulgent big brother to her chaos.

sam.thread: why Oswin came on the adventure

anyone.name: Anyone (a person without a voice sheet)
anyone.personality: A plain voice for any person in a scene who has no voice sheet of their own: a shopkeeper, a guard, a priest or a smuggler alike. Natural, a little wary of strangers, never names themselves or their job.
never: anything that only fits one job
samples: What can I do for you?
I don't know anything about that.
Good to see a friendly face.
